name: Xia He
source:
With the arrival of summer vacation, the male protagonist applied for a summer job, and naturally met our beautiful girls by the sea.

Then an interesting love story happened.

"Sometimes, first love is just a joke.

Sometimes, first love is a sweet memory, but full of embarrassment when you are young. "

Come to Summer Lotus and experience an interesting and moving story.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/931470/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
随着暑假的到来，男主申请了一份暑期工，自然而然地在海边遇见了我们美丽的姑娘们。

随后，一段有趣的爱情故事发生了。

“有时候，初恋只是一个笑话。

有时候，初恋是一段甜蜜的回忆，却充满了年轻时的尴尬。”

来到夏荷，体验一个有趣又感人的故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/931470/]Steam[/url]]
